title: ScriptDocumentV2
description: Editor-independent ScriptDocument with structural primary visuals and independent overlay timing.

ideaOutline.description: Reserved document surface; it remains empty until its owning contract is introduced.

extras.description: Reserved document surface; it remains empty until its owning contract is introduced.

liveStateVector.description: Base64-encoded acknowledged collaborative state-vector evidence; it may be empty before collaboration exists.

rowEditRevision.description: Local optimistic whole-row revision; absent means zero. Does not acknowledge or advance the collaborative live head.

stash.description: Saved whole-row scratchpad, separate from Ideas/Extras and never build-eligible. Array and row order are authoritative.

stashSections.description: Optional user-created Stash headings and their ordered saved-row membership.

stashOutline.description: Optional canonical mixed Stash order and note-parent relationships. When present, every saved row appears exactly once and stashSections rowIds are empty.

stashGroups.description: Optional persisted organization of adjacent ordinary saved rows. Members reference canonical Stash identities, never copied row payloads or nested groups.

rowTransitions.description: Explicit picture-transition intent at an opening or between rows. Intent does not transfer automatically to new neighbors.

rowAudioSpans.description: Saved row-span audio intent. The music build uses compiled active-row geometry and an explicit verified local file binding; a missing file is reported and omitted.

ProjectRelativePath.description: Canonical slash-separated project-relative locator; absolute paths and dot segments are not accepted.

NarrationToken.description: Stable text-token identity plus UTF-16 offsets into NarrationBlockV2.text. Omitted spoken means spoken; false marks a nonspoken token in a recognized paired direction or a whole-row plain direction.

TextAnchorRange.description: Exact authored text range. Token existence, order and quoted-text agreement remain semantic validation.

NarrationAnnotation.description: Typed, exact-range pronunciation or performance metadata. It is never spoken narration or provider syntax.

PerformanceBeat.description: Stable recording-take identity over an exact narration token range.

wantedPictureKind.description: The type the writer chose for this visual before picking its media (Change type to Footage, Still Image, Web Capture or Graphic with nothing selected yet). Omitted for an ordinary Need to Find.

ImageMotionFrameV1.description: Source-normalized focus and scale relative to the selected framing policy; runtime qualification, not this schema, decides the safe Resolve envelope.

ImageMotionV1.description: Explicit image motion intent. No numeric product preset is implied: native motion requires frozen endpoints and easing; unsupported settings must fail at delivery rather than being silently changed.

displayName.description: Optional name for this visual placement only, never the referenced media source.

imageMotion.description: Per-occurrence still-image override; absent inherits the frozen authoring default.

researchStill.description: Immutable Research kept-still identity and original asset pin for this image occurrence. Display and thumbnail assets are acquired later and are never persisted here.

showResearchStillCredit.description: Per-occurrence on-screen credit; absent is off.

researchQuotePicture.description: Immutable original image pin selected for a Research quote background.

framing.description: Wide or Tight presenter framing for this On Camera passage. Omission means wide. On Camera fills the narration no visual covers; only this choice is authored.

slotId.description: The content slot ID the visual had while it was attached, kept so reattachment and occurrence bindings can reuse it.

citationOverridden.description: The per-use citationText and italicSpan were edited locally and survive a refresh from Research.

plainDirection.description: Whole-row nonspoken intent: text is exact literal content, including square brackets, never a parsed direction delimiter. Omit for ordinary and legacy narration; false is not a valid value.

annotations.description: Optional typed narration annotations. Omission is equivalent to an empty array.

performanceBeats.description: Optional explicit performance beats. Omission or an empty array derives deterministic sentence beats at export time.

attachedFootage.description: Explicitly owned footage clip; never an ordinary Stash outline row. The contained clip row is authoritative until converted into an active visual occurrence.

unattachedVisuals.description: Deliberately placed visuals that lost every anchor word in a range edit. They are kept for Attach to words recovery and are never built. On Camera is never stored here. Omission is equivalent to an empty array.

systemPreservedDefaultHold.description: The fixed hold was materialized from the prior effective system default to keep wordless playout unchanged. Omitted for custom or unknown-origin fixed holds.

matchAudioDuration.description: Explicit opt-in to match this untimed visual's duration to one saved music cue. The fixed hold remains the fallback if the match is cleared.

displayName.description: Optional name for this visual placement only, never the referenced media source.

imageMotion.description: Per-occurrence still-image override; absent inherits the frozen authoring default.

clearedNarration.description: The picture sequence of a wordless row that came from clearing editable narration.

createdBy.description: Optional creator identity for the group only; does not change member authorship.

StashChecklistV2.description: Manual toggles and a first automatic check are separate persisted events. Returns never count active copies.

precedingSiblingRowIds.description: Original preceding siblings, nearest first. Frozen when leaving Stash; absent in legacy documents.

followingSiblingRowIds.description: Original following siblings, nearest first. Frozen when leaving Stash; absent in legacy documents.

originalParentContext.description: Frozen position of the original note parent, to distinguish a moved parent from an interposed unrelated peer.

sourceNoteRowId.description: Stable original Stash note identity for a copied spoken row; a missing source is not resurrected.

sourceContentStamp.description: Exact frozen authored source/attachment content at placement, excluding checklist toggles and organization.

completionCaused.description: Whether this insertion was the first unchecked-to-checked transition.

originalAttachedNoteRowId.description: Historical exclusive owner note for an independently placed clip. Not a current ownership edge.

originalAttachedNoteParentRowId.description: The note's Stash parent at separation; null for a root. Used to reject stale reattachment after a move.

originalAttachedNoteAfterSiblingRowId.description: Historical preceding sibling of the owner note for an anchored ordinary return.

originalAttachedNoteBeforeSiblingRowId.description: Historical following sibling of the owner note for an anchored ordinary return.

parentRowId.description: Original parent of the note parent, or null when the note parent was a root.

precedingSiblingRowIds.description: Original peers before the note parent, nearest first.

followingSiblingRowIds.description: Original peers after the note parent, nearest first.

fromRowId.description: Omit only for an opening fade from black into the first active timeline row.

settings.description: For an active named picture transition, exactly one durationFrames (positive even whole frames) or durationSeconds ({numerator,denominator} positive rational mapping exactly to even frames at the frozen timeline rate), with optional alignment left/center/right (default center). Saved needs_review settings remain opaque. The compiler validates active settings; the editor preserves inactive values.

ResearchMusicSelectionV2.description: Exact saved Research item and kept original used to prepare a zero-based selection WAV.

enum: Music now ends with this row. Review

settings.description: Per-cue gain and optional fade-out duration. Legacy probe settings can still be saved; the compiler checks which settings it can deliver.

fadeOutMs.description: Explicit fade-out in milliseconds, including zero. Omit for the legacy short fade.

MusicCueTimingV2.description: Exactly three fixed points at normal playback speed. Omit the point to derive. Source points are frame boundaries on the build's timeline rate.
